params.name: vpAreaName
params.description: 4D View Pro area form object name

params.name: column
params.description: Index of the column in the table

params.name: attributes
params.description: Attribute(s) to apply to the column (dataField, name, formula, footerText, footerFormula, filterButtonVisible)

params.name: sheet
params.description: Sheet index (current sheet if omitted or -1)

sentinelValues.meaning: Applies to the current sheet (same as omitting sheet).

overloads.semanticRole: The VP SET TABLE COLUMN ATTRIBUTES command applies the defined attributes to the column in the tableName .

constraints: If tableName is not found, or if column is higher than the number of columns in the table, the command does nothing.
Setting name to a value already used by another column in the table is not applied; the table's default column name is used instead.
